title: Tier-I General Intelligence & Reasoning — Analogies
research_effort: Low–medium (2–4 hours for mapping, examples and independent check)
visual_lesson_suitability: High; relation diagrams and visual analogy examples
question_flashcard_opportunities: Original analogy examples; relation categories; explanation cards
academic_risks: Ensure examples genuinely test a relation and one answer is defensible; 2027 confirmation pending.

title: Tier-I Quantitative Aptitude — Percentage
visual_lesson_suitability: High; percentage bars and worked calculations
question_flashcard_opportunities: Original calculations, conversions and method-selection cards
academic_risks: Independently calculate every answer; avoid ambiguity in base value; 2027 confirmation pending.

title: Tier-I English Comprehension — basic comprehension
visual_lesson_suitability: Medium; readable passage and evidence-highlight interface
question_flashcard_opportunities: Inference, main idea and vocabulary-in-context cards using original passage
academic_risks: Use original passage; answers must be supported by text; don't silently import Tier-II syllabus.

title: Tier-I General Awareness — History (narrow, sourced subtopic)
research_effort: Medium–high (4–6 hours for topic boundary and fact audit)
visual_lesson_suitability: High; timelines and maps if appropriate
academic_risks: History is official broad scope; specific chapter boundary is editorial and must be justified. 2027 confirmation pending.

title: Tier-II Paper-I — Mathematical Abilities: Number Systems

academic_risks: Keep Tier-II mapping separate from Tier-I Quantitative Aptitude; Tier-II level described separately.
